localBiteReport: Note: The most current dated report found is from Half Hitch (September 28, 2026 — about 10 days old); the Captain Experiences Choctawhatchee Bay page shows reports filed 1–2 days and 1 week ago. With water at 83°F, the inshore bay bite is described as heating up as October and the Destin Fishing Rodeo kick off. Redfish and speckled trout in the bayous are the standout targets right now, with guides noting active action despite intermittent rain and small-craft advisories this past week. The mullet run is underway in the bay, which is concentrating bait and drawing in reds — look for them around bayou grass edges, bridge pilings, and the river systems on moving water. The Half Hitch 9-28-26 report exists and is the most recent from that local source, but its full bay-fishing content was not retrievable in search results.
